method: Separate local models: retained Neckar affine for Bergstrasse only; four-city source-to-geography fit then Frankfurt/Wurzburg/Heidelberg native affine for Oberstift. Observed city symbols, not labels, determine controls. Territorial envelopes follow depicted secular jurisdiction, not diocese or town-radius partitions.

calibrated_sources.scope: Bergstrasse south of Darmstadt only. Not Orb or northern Hesse.

Specific Oberstift map (not the discarded all-Empire dynastic aggregate). 1789 ownership applied only to secular Mainz territories corroborated as unchanged in 1776. Native three-point fit is exact by construction, not an independent engine accuracy measure.

polygons.territory: Lorsch, Bensheim, Heppenheim/Starkenburg, remaining Viernheim connection; excludes Palatine/Worms enclaves and northern Darmstadt.

exclusions.name: Depicted Palatine enclave west of Bensheim

polygons.territory: Secular Mainz Oberstift: Steinheim/Seligenstadt/Dieburg, Aschaffenburg-Spessart, Orb/Lohr, Klingenberg-Miltenberg-Amorbach and southern Mainz complex; clipped to approved existing imperial regions.

limitations: Game-resolution sovereign envelopes, not a cadastral reconstruction. Tiny knightly enclaves remain abstracted, never enlarged.
Bergstrasse uses an older primary map with confirmed Mainz continuity. Lorsch/Heppenheim are not confused with the later Hessian province named Starkenburg.
Detailed Oberstift comparison is dated 1789; unchanged 1776 secular lordships are corroborated separately. Administrative reforms of 1782 are not projected onto the starting government.
Rieneck/Nostitz, Wertheim, Erbach and Wurzburg are not merged into Mainz. Unchanged residual owners are not thereby certified historically correct.
The old small Aschaffenburg envelope is geographically refined; outside its new source-confirmed envelope, the old unresolved BAV controller is restored without certifying Bavarian sovereignty.

The one-pixel contact with the retained Palatine Ladenburg RGB and the three-pixel contact with previously traced Wurzburg fringes are abstracted in their prior holder, within native/source alignment uncertainty; no invisible enclave is artificially enlarged.
Northern remote Mainz estates (Erfurt/Eichsfeld etc.) and the still coarse Mainz/Rheingau core are separate from this Bergstrasse/Oberstift lot.

Oberstift southern Tauber/Jagst extensions beyond Miltenberg-Amorbach (Buchen, Tauberbischofsheim, Krautheim) are not merged into the current three-region pass; they need their own southern regional dependencies. No claim that all Mainz possessions are complete.
Demographic allocations preserve each existing profile exactly; area weights are a gameplay approximation, not a census. Engine test deferred until all HRE lots.
